caption: The drawing depicts a side view of a river steamboat labeled "IDLEWILD" on the hull and on a large central red paddle wheel that features a white star in its center. The boat's body is primarily white with gray shading and black window outlines. There are two decks, each with railings and small windows. At the rear of the upper deck are two lifeboats supported by metal framework. Two smokestacks, one black and one gray, rise vertically from the structure near the middle of the boat. A golden eagle figurehead sits atop a white cabin structure near the front, which also has red doors and accents. Three vertical poles with gold finials are present: one at the front with a blue flag, one at the top center with a string of small flags, and one at the rear with a blue flag and a United States flag. The waterline is depicted with light blue shading along the lower part of the hull. The background is plain and uncolored, and there is a signature reading "Frank Wheatley" in the lower right corner.
title: Model Ship "Idlewild"
